It shall be possible to forward I-PDUs in a n:1 fashion. Only one source shall be enabled at one time, using the PduR_EnableRouting and PduR_- DisableRouting respectively. PduRIsEnabledAtInit shall be used to ensure this condition at startup. This does not apply when forwarding from communication interface modules to an upper layer module.
